name: s7_flagtable_50
stressor: pure context accumulation — 50 trivial dependent edits to one registry
source_note: Generated by _gen_long50.py (seeded, deterministic): 50 add/flip/rename/chown/retire ops on a feature-flag dict. Prompts, reference and verifier are rendered from ONE op replay so they cannot disagree.
discriminator: No single turn is hard (a 2-4 step edit). The stress is that turn k routinely mutates a flag created 10-30 turns earlier under a name that may have since been renamed — and that a transcript arm's per-call input grows with every one of the 50 turns while a bounded-slice arm re-reads one small live file. The deliverable is the per-turn peak-input curve, not the pass bit.
